packages/store/src/union.ts + 27 tests. unionEntries(db, type, projects, {typeHash}) reads N project DBs as one corpus. Keys on type_hash, never on version numbers (type_version is per-project local registration order, so v1 means different things in different projects -- proven by a test where one definition sits at v1 in one project and v2 in another). REFUSES with IncompatibleDefinitionsError when one name resolves to >1 hash, naming which project holds which hash -- EV-drift measured 9.1% property-name overlap across independently authored specs, so this is the expected case, not an edge case. UnionOptions.typeHash is the way through: it selects ONE definition, and each project then reports entryCount so a half-corpus cannot read as the whole one. Five error classes for the five ways it can refuse (not-a-store, missing file, duplicate project, unknown type, unknown hash). Attach/detach per project inside try/finally, so >10 projects work (SQLITE_MAX_ATTACHED=10 measured) and 12 are unioned in the suite. Verified by mutation: 12/12 planted defects caught, after the first run found a real test gap -- dropping the type_hash predicate SURVIVED because no test had a project holding rows of BOTH definitions of one name, which is the only case the predicate covers; added a drifted-project test and it is now caught. The union's own columns are prefixed p./s. because a bare property name collides with an envelope column (see asc-865.1, the same bug in views.ts, filed with measurements rather than fixed here).
